narratives.Description: Official root .no-deft-directive flag; session/doctor/setup short-circuit; docs+tests+CHANGELOG; inconsistent flag+deposit diagnosed.
narratives.Overview: Define an official per-project file flag that marks a repository as not using Deft Directive. Presence of root `.no-deft-directive` disables install pressure, session ritual, doctor setup path, and init/update mutations. Flag wins locally over trusted-org force-on. Flag+deposit is inconsistent: doctor warns; mutating paths fail closed.
narratives.ImplementationPlan: policy/no-deft-directive.ts detection + create/remove; wire session:start, doctor, init, update; org-force-on skip; content/docs/no-deft-directive.md + pointers; setup skill early check; policy:disable-directive / enable-directive; targeted vitest 33/33; CLI smoke; CHANGELOG; skills-pack body update.
